description: An application submitted under Section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a non-material amendment in connection with the planning permission dated 12/03/2025 (Reference: 24/1225/F) for "Demolition of existing buildings and construction of a multi-storey plus basement building to be used as self-storage (Class B8), and associated landscaping, vehicle manoeuvring and car parking, and refurbishment of the Locally Listed Building to the front of the site.", to vary Conditions 3 (Approved Drawings), 11 (Landscape Strategy), 22 (Refuse and Recycling) and 23 (Cycle Parking) by substituting approved drawings to ensure that they consistently reflect the revised site access arrangements.
site_name: 260 ELTHAM HIGH STREET, ELTHAM, LONDON, SE9 1AA
